name: zdeclient_map_tree_insert_at
description: zDEClient_MapTreeState::InsertAt allocates a map-tree node, links it under the hinted parent, updates header extents, performs red-black insertion fixup, and returns the inserted node through the caller's output reference.
known_limits: The source restores the VC5 std::_Tree insertion behavior and provider-owned std::_Lockit guard trigger; full tier S remains deferred to the coherent zDEClient map-tree class/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4585a0 validates node allocation, left/right nil initialization, parent assignment, single-dword key copy, node-count increment, left/right insertion based on hint and key order, header left/root/right updates, red-black recolor/rotation fixup, root recolor to black, and writing the inserted node to the output pointer.

The native map-tree insertion smoke verifies root, left-child, and right-child insertions; header root/left/right maintenance; key storage; node count increments; inserted-node return; and successor traversal across the inserted tree.
